items.title: James Chirillo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: And I subbed for Bucky playing rhythm on one track of that “Sweet and Lowdown.”

ctx.x: Right. I was like amazed at the detail that, like I forget that there are people that are crazy about absolutely everything. But he’s worth being crazy about. But I had never heard — Bucky explained a little bit of the way he thinks about it and it made sense. But you’re talking about using a little fingernail.
In this end, right. That’s right. Well Bucky will tell you that too if you really start asking him about different things.
Oh it’s a right hand thing.
